zh: 只有辅音字母参与计数，元音、空格、数字和标点既不计数也不改变；被替换的是第 n、2n、3n……个辅音。
“下一个辅音”就是在字母表中往后找第一个不是元音的字母，越过 z 就回到 a 继续找，所以 z 变成 b；替换后要保持原来的大小写。
第一行读出 n，第二行整行原样保留（包括首尾和连续空格，也可能是空行）；逐字符处理，遇到辅音计数加一，计数是 n 的倍数时按小写形式找到下一个辅音再恢复大小写，其他字符原样保留；最后输出整行，只以一个换行结尾。
en: Only consonant letters are counted; vowels, spaces, digits and punctuation are neither counted nor changed, and the replaced characters are the n-th, 2n-th, 3n-th, ... consonants.
The next consonant is the first letter after it in the alphabet that is not a vowel, wrapping from z back to a, so z becomes b; the replacement keeps the original case.

Read n from the first line and keep the second line exactly as it is (leading, trailing and repeated spaces included; it may also be empty); process it character by character, counting consonants, and when the count is a multiple of n find the next consonant of the lowercase form and restore the case, leaving every other character untouched; print the whole line followed by a single newline.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain a consonant counter; at every multiple of n, move the character forward to the next English letter that is not a vowel, continuing from a after passing z; finally restore the original case.

## Proof of correctness

The counter only increases on consonants, so the replaced positions are exactly the n-th, 2n-th, 3n-th, ... consonants. Searching through the alphabet cyclically and skipping vowels gives exactly the next consonant defined by the problem, and all other characters stay unchanged.

## Complexity

Time O(L), output space O(L).
